title: WS-1: Make MAP authority freshness truthful
description: Child of TASK-309. Define and implement one authority-revision and freshness contract across map-authority, generated current state, runner output, and Command Center-facing health so a stale but internally consistent Biggie mirror cannot present as globally healthy. Start with a durable contract and collision scan; add implementation output paths only after ownership is proven.
acceptance_criteria: Every operator-facing state view names authority host, authority revision, last successful sync time, and freshness classification.
Disconnecting or making Smalls unreachable produces STALE or UNAVAILABLE, never green/current.
Biggie remains read-only and no second lifecycle authority, scheduler, or derived truth source is created.
Focused tests cover fresh, stale, unavailable, clock-skew, rollback, and last-good-snapshot behavior; an independent core agent reviews the result.
